name: osdbits-wasm
description: Browser-native Rust/WASM + WebGPU clean-room reconstruction of the PlayStation 2 OSDSYS visual experience

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.lint: eslint src tests scripts playwright.config.ts vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
scripts.test:wasm: npm run build:wasm && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts tests/wasm
scripts.test:perf: npm run build:wasm && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts tests/perf
scripts.verify:all: npm run check:hygiene && npm run check:rust && npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:wasm && npm run test:perf && npm run test:e2e
